quote: CAPEX totaled R$1.0 billion in 2Q26, and in 6M26 reached 45% of the total planned for the year. Of the amount invested in the quarter, 44% was allocated to Maintenance and 56% to Competitiveness … In 2Q26, 80% of the CAPEX were allocated to operations in Brazil. We continue to make progress toward completing the integrated testing phase of the Miguel Burnier sustainable mining platform … scrap processing project in Pindamonhangaba.
note: Opened Gerdau SEC 6-K 2Q26 Exhibit 99.1; CapEx R$1.0bn with 80% Brazil allocation confirmed. Enter R$800m LatAm face. CapEx USD via Fed H.10 Sep 25 2026 5.1921.
